title: Breezy Hill Campground

services.name: Cabin stay
services.desc: Our beautiful, rustic cabins are equipped with electricity, ceiling fan, air conditioner and an electric heater. These cabins have a covered porch with porch swing, a picnic table, a charcoal grill, fire pit, and parking area. Please bring your own linens. No pets allowed in the cabins. Cancellations less than two weeks prior to your stay will result in forfeiture of the deposit unless within the time frames below. Prices subject to change without notice. Regular Season - If reservation is cancelled 2 WEEKS or more prior to arrival date a camping voucher is issued minus $25.00 processing fee. There is an air conditioner, furnace, microwave, stove, TV DVD player radio, and spacious refrigerator. Dishes and silverware are included for your use. Please bring your linens and towels. blurb: At our campground near Fond du Lac, WI we offer you a chance to get away from the city without driving a long distance! We have a beautiful pond, lots of activities for the kids, and options when it comes to how you want to camp! Located just a short distance from Milwaukee, Madison, and Green Bay.
